rows.text: The Bank of Canada today held its target for the overnight rate at the effective lower bound of ¼ percent, with the Bank Rate at ½ percent and the deposit rate at ¼ percent.
Bank of Canada maintains policy rate and forward guidance
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
The Bank’s extraordinary forward guidance on the path for the overnight rate is being maintained.
The Bank is continuing its reinvestment phase, keeping its overall holdings of Government of Canada bonds roughly constant.
